thread:
maria: Heads-up: quick review needed on CTA placement for invoice download on the usage page. Current comp has a small link under each account card and a global button in the toolbar. Folks keep mistaking the global for exporting the whole org.
daniel: I noticed that too. Two problems: discoverability for per-account invoices, and accidental org-level exports. My recommendation: surface per-account invoice in the card but keep a single global 'Download all invoices' in the toolbar. Use clear labels.
priya: Accessibility concerns: avoid icon-only buttons, and dont hide the invoice link inside menus only. Keyboard users should be able to reach per-account downloads with 1 tab per card. Add aria-labels that include account name.
alex: Viz thought: token breakdown in each card — should we use mini stacked bars (showing projects) or a tiny area sparkline for trend + a micro legend? Stacked bar shows distribution at-a-glance.
maria: Love the stacked bar idea for distribution, sparkline for trend. Proposal: line 1 = account name + small scope badge, line 2 = stacked bar + percent numbers, right side = compact action group [Download PDF] [Export CSV] kebab.
ken: About scope: people are confused whether numbers are org vs project. We should add a small inline breadcrumb above the header: "Scope: Org  AcmeCorp > Viewing: Projects" with a clear change action. Defaults: org-admins see org, non-admins see project.
daniel: Also suggest permission gating the global download button — only org billing roles can see it. Others see per-account only. Prevents accidental mass downloads and helps UX.
priya: For colors: pick a palette designed for colorblind palettes (Okabe-Ito or similar) and add patterns to stacked bars when in high-contrast mode. Legends must include text labels + percentage to avoid color reliance.
alex: Quick ARIA example for per-card download: ```html
<button class="card-download" aria-label="Download invoice for AcmeCorp - July 2025 (PDF)">Download invoice (PDF)</button>
```
This ensures screen readers announce the account and file type.
maria: Good. Copy tweak: prefer explicit labels like "Download invoice (PDF)" and "Export usage (CSV)". Legal teams care about the PDF naming so be explicit.
ken: Mobile: collapse per-card actions into a visible row beneath the stacked bar. Avoid nested menus. For very small screens use a full-width single CTA at bottom of card.
daniel: Tiny UX polish: reduce top padding on cards so the stacked bars align better with headings, and make the per-card action group right-aligned to avoid scan confusion.
priya: Also add live region announcements for long-running invoice generation: e.g., "Invoice for AcmeCorp requested. You will be notified when ready." Then billing-bot can post a channel message or trigger an email. Screen reader users need timely feedback.
billing-bot: Invoice generation queued for acct-4321. Estimated ready in ~2m. Preview: https://invoices.redwood.example/preview/4321
maria: Nice. One more debate: inline donuts on hover for more detail vs an expand drawer. I'm leaning to an expand panel that shows full legend, downloadable CSV per line item, and a small table. Hover-only tooltip is hard on touch devices.
alex: Expand panel it is. I'll add a small interaction note: panel opens on click, has focus trap, ESC closes, and a close button with aria-label.
daniel: Can we get quick comps A/B? A = toolbar global + per-card PDF button, B = toolbar only with per-card link in overflow. Prefer A.
maria: I'll schedule a short review in #design-review tomorrow at 10am PT. Alex, drop both variants in Figma before EOD. Thanks everyone!
